say:0:1029201001:0.text: I can't stand it! Will these days never end?!
say:0:1029201001:0.source_cn: 我受不了，这日子什么时候是个头！

say:1:1029201002:0.text: I can't do this anymore. I've gotta get out of here too.
say:1:1029201002:0.source_cn: 我不行了，我也要逃跑了。

say:3:1029201004:0.text: How many has it been now? 1010?

say:1:1029202001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I was worried there wasn't anyone to fight, but then here you are.

say:4:1029202003:1.source_cn: 竟然回绝地如此果断……莫非你找到了更强的对手？请一定要...
say:4:1029202003:1.male: So decisive in refusal... Could you have possibly found an even stronger opponent? Please, you must introduce him to me!
say:4:1029202003:1.female: So decisive in refusal... Could you have possibly found an even stronger opponent? Please, you must introduce him to me!

say:6:1029202004:1.male: Don't think that everyone is like you! Magister isn't crazy about fighting!
say:6:1029202004:1.female: Don't think that everyone is like you! Magister isn't crazy about fighting!

say:7:1029202008:2.text: A real shame. I can't believe we wouldn't be able to have our final duel before I left!
say:7:1029202008:2.source_cn: 真是遗憾，没想到我离开前竟然不能和你最后一战！
say:7:1029202008:2.male: A real shame. I can't believe we wouldn't be able to have our final duel before I left!
say:7:1029202008:2.female: A real shame. I can't believe we wouldn't be able to have our final duel before I left!

choice_prompt:8:1029202008.male: A real shame. I can't believe we wouldn't be able to have our final duel before I left!
choice_prompt:8:1029202008.female: A real shame. I can't believe we wouldn't be able to have our final duel before I left!

say:9:1029202009:3.text: I came here to train for the Warsong Festival. It kicks off in a few days, and I want to get back to the Ashen Wastes before it starts.
say:9:1029202009:3.source_cn: 我为了参加战歌节，而来到这里磨练。战歌节过些日子就会重...

say:10:1029202010:3.text: What's more, many golems have stopped working, so the Syndicate has let us go. Even if I stayed here, I wouldn't be able to sharpen my skills with the golems. It's a waste of time.
say:10:1029202010:3.source_cn: 而且很多魔偶停止了行动，黑金商会也解雇了我们。我即使留...

say:11:1029202011:3.text: But before that, there's actually something worrying me—the treasure thieves here.
say:11:1029202011:3.source_cn: 但是在那之前，我确实还有一件事放心不下……就是这里的盗...

say:12:1029202012:1.text: It's impossible to overlook just how weak they are.
say:12:1029202012:1.source_cn: 他们实在太过弱小，弱小到让人无法置之不理。

say:13:1029202013:3.text: That's why I've been giving them some special training. Of course, it's much gentler than the training I had in mind for myself.
say:13:1029202013:3.source_cn: 因此，我对他们进行了一番特训。当然，比我给自己制定的特...

choice_prompt:14:1029202013.text: That's why I've been giving them some special training. Of course, it's much gentler than the training I had in mind for myself.
choice_prompt:14:1029202013.source_cn: 因此，我对他们进行了一番特训。当然，比我给自己制定的特训计划要轻量许多。

say:15:1029202014:1.text: Very effective. At least they finally understand how disgusting being weak is...
say:15:1029202014:1.source_cn: 特训还是有效的，至少让他们意识到了“弱小”是多么令人生厌——

say:16:1029202015:2.text: They've all been sulking since training began. They must be ashamed of their own lack of strength.
say:16:1029202015:2.source_cn: 自从特训开始之后，他们每个人都哭丧着脸，一定是对自己的...

say:18:1029202017:1.text: Were the treasure thieves always this humble?
say:18:1029202017:1.source_cn: 那个……盗宝贼们竟然这么有谦逊吗？

say:20:1029202018:2.text: Of course not! Silly Chippy, don't try to follow the logic of this battle-crazed maniac!
say:20:1029202018:2.source_cn: 肯定不是吧！笨蛋满满，你别顺着这个战斗狂的逻辑思考呀！

say:21:1029202019:3.text: Anyway, my special training's developed a rather serious problem. Some of the treasure thieves, so ashamed of being weak, decided to run away!
say:21:1029202019:3.source_cn: 总之，我的特别集训遇到了一个严重的问题。有一些盗宝贼，...

choice_prompt:22:1029202019.text: Anyway, my special training's developed a rather serious problem. Some of the treasure thieves, so ashamed of being weak, decided to run away!
choice_prompt:22:1029202019.source_cn: 总之，我的特别集训遇到了一个严重的问题。有一些盗宝贼，因为太过羞愧于自己的弱小，直接逃跑了。

say:24:1029202020:0.text: What?! Those guys... Did they actually run away because they couldn't handle my training?
say:24:1029202020:0.source_cn: 什么！那些家伙……原来是因为扛不住我的特训才逃跑的吗？
say:24:1029202020:0.male: What?! Those guys... Did they actually run away because they couldn't handle my training?
say:24:1029202020:0.female: What?! Those guys... Did they actually run away because they couldn't handle my training?

say:25:1029202021:0.text: They can't even stick to such easy training, with their lack of perseverance... It must be because they don't trust enough in their own strength!
say:25:1029202021:0.source_cn: 这么轻松的训练都坚持不住，如此缺乏毅力……一定是因为没...

say:26:1029202022:1.text: Can I ask a favor of you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Please help train these folks for me.
say:26:1029202022:1.male: Can I ask a favor of you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Please help train these folks for me.
say:26:1029202022:1.female: Can I ask a favor of you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Please help train these folks for me.

say:27:1029202023:1.text: It won't take too long, just a few days. I need to leave for a little while—to catch all those deserters myself.
say:27:1029202023:1.source_cn: 不会很久的，几天就可以。我需要稍微离开一段时间——去把...
say:27:1029202023:1.male: It won't take too long, just a few days. I need to leave for a little while—to catch all those deserters myself.
say:27:1029202023:1.female: It won't take too long, just a few days. I need to leave for a little while—to catch all those deserters myself.

choice_prompt:28:1029202023.text: It won't take too long, just a few days. I need to leave for a little while—to catch all those deserters myself.
choice_prompt:28:1029202023.source_cn: 不会很久的，几天就可以。我需要稍微离开一段时间——去把那些逃兵全部亲手抓回来。
choice_prompt:28:1029202023.male: It won't take too long, just a few days. I need to leave for a little while—to catch all those deserters myself.
choice_prompt:28:1029202023.female: It won't take too long, just a few days. I need to leave for a little while—to catch all those deserters myself.

say:29:1029202024:1.text: Don't worry. I trust in your strength!
say:29:1029202024:1.male: Don't worry. I trust in your strength!
say:29:1029202024:1.female: Don't worry. I trust in your strength!

choice:22:0:1.source_cn: 逃跑的原因难道不是因为集训吗……

choice:22:1:2.text: Why do you think they ran away?
choice:22:1:2.male: Why do you think they ran away?
choice:22:1:2.female: Why do you think they ran away?

say:31:1029202016:1.text: That's for sure. They're scared of training, probably because they're humiliated by their terribly weak muscles!
say:31:1029202016:1.source_cn: 确实，他们对于特训非常恐惧，一定是因为实力太差而深感丢脸！

choice:14:1:2.text: These guys must be hard to handle...
choice:14:1:2.male: These guys must be hard to handle...
choice:14:1:2.female: These guys must be hard to handle...

choice:8:1:2.text: You're just gonna leave like that?
choice:8:1:2.male: You're just gonna leave like that?
choice:8:1:2.female: You're just gonna leave like that?

say:32:1029202005:1.text: Such a pity. Can you really not hear it? All that magic flowing inside you, constantly clamoring for battle...
say:32:1029202005:1.source_cn: 太可惜了。你难道听不见吗？你身体里所流淌着的充沛魔力，...

say:34:1029202006:2.text: R-really? The magister's magic... really makes a noise?
say:34:1029202006:2.source_cn: 真、真的吗，主人身上的魔力……真的会发出声音吗？
say:34:1029202006:2.male: R-really? The magister's magic... really makes a noise?
say:34:1029202006:2.female: R-really? The magister's magic... really makes a noise?

say:1:1029204001:1.text: Enough! Please stop beating me up! I'll talk, I'll tell you everything!
say:1:1029204001:1.source_cn: 好了好了别打了！我说我说，我什么都说！

choice_prompt:2:1029204001.text: Enough! Please stop beating me up! I'll talk, I'll tell you everything!
choice_prompt:2:1029204001.source_cn: 好了好了别打了！我说我说，我什么都说！

say:3:1029204002:1.text: You... How can you be even scarier than that battle freak?!
say:3:1029204002:1.source_cn: 你……你怎么比那个粗鲁的战斗狂还可怕！
say:3:1029204002:1.male: You... How can you be even scarier than that battle freak?!
say:3:1029204002:1.female: You... How can you be even scarier than that battle freak?!

say:4:1029204003:1.text: I just wanted to take it easy... I'm not even getting paid; who'd wanna stay here?!
say:4:1029204003:1.source_cn: 我只是想偷懒而已……都发不出来工钱了，谁还愿意待在这里！

say:5:1029204004:1.text: This training is exhausting and painful. If I'd known, I'd have gone together with them!
say:5:1029204004:1.source_cn: 参加这个破特训，又累又难受。早知道，就跟他们一起走了！

choice_prompt:6:1029204004.text: This training is exhausting and painful. If I'd known, I'd have gone together with them!
choice_prompt:6:1029204004.source_cn: 参加这个破特训，又累又难受。早知道，就跟他们一起走了！

say:7:1029204005:1.text: Oh, my big mouth... You can't breathe a word to anyone else, but those guys who escaped...
say:7:1029204005:1.source_cn: 唉，我这个破嘴……你不要跟其他人乱说，其实是那几个逃跑...
say:7:1029204005:1.male: Oh, my big mouth... You can't breathe a word to anyone else, but those guys who escaped...
say:7:1029204005:1.female: Oh, my big mouth... You can't breathe a word to anyone else, but those guys who escaped...

say:8:1029204006:1.text: They said a "major deal" had recently come up, and they wanted to go to a secluded place and discuss it in detail.
say:8:1029204006:1.source_cn: 他们说最近有一笔“大生意”，要到一个隐蔽的地方详谈。

say:10:1029204007:2.text: "Major deal"? That sounds suspicious. What exactly do they want to do?
say:10:1029204007:2.source_cn: “大生意”？听着就很可疑，他们到底是做什么去了？

say:11:1029204008:2.text: I-I don't know! If I did, don't you think I would have gone with them?
say:11:1029204008:2.source_cn: 这，这我可就不知道了啊！我要是知道，早就和他们一起溜出去了！

say:12:1029204009:1.text: Before they left, they wanted me to help cover for them, saying they'd share the profits later...
say:12:1029204009:1.source_cn: 他们走之前还让我们帮忙掩护，说是后面有好处会和大家一起分……

say:13:1029204010:2.text: Damn, I should never have believed their rubbish. We're obviously the only ones left to take the beatings...
say:13:1029204010:2.source_cn: 可恶，我就不该信那几个人的鬼话，结果明明只有我们留下来...

say:15:1029204011:2.text: Come clean—what else do you know?!
say:15:1029204011:2.source_cn: 你老实交代，还有没有别的信息！

say:16:1029204012:1.text: I've already told you everything! There's nothing else, really! Listen, go ask Rofis; he knows more!
say:16:1029204012:1.source_cn: 我已经把我知道的事情都告诉你了啊！再多就真的没有了！嗯...

choice:2:0:1.text: What do you have to say?
choice:2:0:1.male: What do you have to say?
choice:2:0:1.female: What do you have to say?

say:0:1029204101:0.text: Phew, the boss has gone. Stop pretending!

say:1:1029204102:0.text: Come have some tea. Try this stuff I just robbed.
say:1:1029204102:0.source_cn: 来来来，喝杯茶先，试试我这刚抢的红茶。

say:2:1029204103:0.text: Well, it looks like mud, and the taste packs a punch...
say:2:1029204103:0.source_cn: 嗯，这泥汤般的色泽，像挨了一榔头般的口感……

say:3:1029204104:0.text: I'm a mage; why am I being trained as a warrior...?
say:3:1029204104:0.source_cn: 我一个法师，练什么空挥啊……

say:4:1029204105:0.text: Perhaps I should sneak off at night, too.

say:2:1029205001:1.text: That girl just spilled the beans. The escaped treasure thieves are involved in some "major deal".
say:2:1029205001:1.source_cn: 刚才那个人已经交代了，逃跑的盗宝贼们在搞一笔“大生意”。

say:3:1029205002:0.text: What do you know about this?

say:4:1029205003:0.text: Oh, er, really? I don't know nothin'!
say:4:1029205003:0.source_cn: 啊，真的吗？我什么都不知道！

choice_prompt:5:1029205003.text: Oh, er, really? I don't know nothin'!
choice_prompt:5:1029205003.source_cn: 啊，真的吗？我什么都不知道！

say:6:1029205004:0.text: No, no! I'll talk! No more training, please...
say:6:1029205004:0.source_cn: 别别别！我说我说，我说还不行吗……

say:7:1029205005:2.text: It's that guy, Robin. He's the issue!
say:7:1029205005:2.source_cn: 是罗宾那家伙，他有问题！

say:8:1029205006:2.text: I overheard him say that he's gonna look for a chance to sneak off tonight and go discuss that "major deal".
say:8:1029205006:2.source_cn: 我也是之前偷听到的，他说今天晚上就要找机会逃跑，去谈那...

say:9:1029205007:0.text: That's all I know, really! If you wanna know more, go find him!
say:9:1029205007:0.source_cn: 我真的就知道这么点了，剩下的你去问罗宾吧，他肯定知道的...

choice:5:1:2.text: How about another round of training?
choice:5:1:2.male: How about another round of training?
choice:5:1:2.female: How about another round of training?

say:0:1029206001:0.text: Magister, are we gonna go catch Robin?
say:0:1029206001:0.source_cn: 主人，我们要去抓罗宾吗？
say:0:1029206001:0.male: Magister, are we gonna go catch Robin?
say:0:1029206001:0.female: Magister, are we gonna go catch Robin?

say:1:1029206002:0.text: There may be more to him than meets the eye. We shouldn't be too hasty.
say:1:1029206002:0.source_cn: 罗宾的背后可能有其他的阴谋，我们先不要轻举妄动。
say:1:1029206002:0.male: There may be more to him than meets the eye. We shouldn't be too hasty.
say:1:1029206002:0.female: There may be more to him than meets the eye. We shouldn't be too hasty.

say:2:1029206003:0.text: Let's follow him tonight and see what's going on.
say:2:1029206003:0.male: Let's follow him tonight and see what's going on.
say:2:1029206003:0.female: Let's follow him tonight and see what's going on.

say:1:1029207002:0.text: Yes. Be careful, and let's follow him.
say:1:1029207002:0.male: Yes. Be careful, and let's follow him.
say:1:1029207002:0.female: Yes. Be careful, and let's follow him.

say:0:1029208001:0.text: Wasn't this the road they said? Surely I can't have remembered wrong...
say:0:1029208001:0.source_cn: 之前说的是这条路吗？我应该没记错吧……

say:1:1029208002:0.text: Ehh, I really hope those guys' words can be trusted.
say:1:1029208002:0.source_cn: 唉，希望那些人说话算话。

say:0:1029209001:0.text: No one saw me sneak off, right?
say:0:1029209001:0.source_cn: 应该没人发现我偷偷溜了吧？

say:1:1029209002:0.text: Why do I always feel chilly? Am I not wearing enough?
say:1:1029209002:0.source_cn: 总感觉凉飕飕的，是我穿得太少了吗？

say:0:1029210001:0.text: Magister, Robin picked up the pace and left! Did he discover us?!
say:0:1029210001:0.source_cn: 主人，罗宾加快脚步离开了！是不是发现我们了？！
say:0:1029210001:0.male: Magister, Robin picked up the pace and left! Did he discover us?!
say:0:1029210001:0.female: Magister, Robin picked up the pace and left! Did he discover us?!

say:0:1029210101:0.text: Phew, running sure warms you up!

say:1:1029210102:0.source_cn: ……看样子，他好像没有发现我们。

say:0:1029212001:0.text: Robin teleported through a magic portal! Should we follow him?
say:0:1029212001:0.source_cn: 主人，罗宾使用魔法门传送走了！我们要追上去吗？
say:0:1029212001:0.male: Robin teleported through a magic portal! Should we follow him?
say:0:1029212001:0.female: Robin teleported through a magic portal! Should we follow him?

say:1:1029212002:0.text: Go take a look. If it's just a portal, it shouldn't present any trouble.
say:1:1029212002:0.source_cn: 过去看看吧。只是魔法门的话，应该不难处理。
say:1:1029212002:0.male: Go take a look. If it's just a portal, it shouldn't present any trouble.
say:1:1029212002:0.female: Go take a look. If it's just a portal, it shouldn't present any trouble.

say:2:1029213003:0.text: Haven't we been here before? Isn't this how the Syndicate transported the golems?
say:2:1029213003:0.source_cn: 这是我们之前来过的，黑金商会的输送魔偶的运道吧？
say:2:1029213003:0.male: Haven't we been here before? Isn't this how the Syndicate transported the golems?
say:2:1029213003:0.female: Haven't we been here before? Isn't this how the Syndicate transported the golems?

say:3:1029213004:0.text: It seems like there are some new tracks here... Let's take a closer look.
say:3:1029213004:0.source_cn: 这里好像有一些新的痕迹……可能是罗宾留下的，调查看看吧。
say:3:1029213004:0.male: It seems like there are some new tracks here... Let's take a closer look.
say:3:1029213004:0.female: It seems like there are some new tracks here... Let's take a closer look.

say:1:1029214001:0.text: Magister, there's a strange noise coming from over there! It can't be a... <shk>ghost?! ARGHH!</shk>
say:1:1029214001:0.source_cn: 主人，那边好像有奇怪的声响！不会是……<shk>幽灵吧...
say:1:1029214001:0.male: Magister, there's a strange noise coming from over there! It can't be a... <shk>ghost?! ARGHH!</shk>
say:1:1029214001:0.female: Magister, there's a strange noise coming from over there! It can't be a... <shk>ghost?! ARGHH!</shk>

say:2:1029214002:0.text: Silly Chippy! There's no ghost here. Could the treasure thieves be having a meeting?
say:2:1029214002:0.source_cn: 笨蛋满满！这里才没有幽灵呢，会不会是盗宝贼们在开会啊？

say:1:1029215001:0.text: Magister, there seem to be some deep claw marks here...
say:1:1029215001:0.source_cn: 主人，这里好像有被爪子抓出来的，很尖锐的痕迹……
say:1:1029215001:0.male: Magister, there seem to be some deep claw marks here...
say:1:1029215001:0.female: Magister, there seem to be some deep claw marks here...

say:2:1029215002:0.text: If my memory serves me right, Robin didn't have any claws...
say:2:1029215002:0.source_cn: 如果我没记错的话……罗宾，应该没长爪子吧？

say:3:1029215003:0.text: Of course not! There's only one <style="highlight">guy with claws</style> nearby, and that's—

choice_prompt:4:1029215003.text: Of course not! There's only one <style="highlight">guy with claws</style> nearby, and that's—
choice_prompt:4:1029215003.source_cn: 当然没有！但<style=stress>用爪子的家伙</style>确实有一个，他就是——

say:6:1029215004:0.text: Who's there? Did I hear my name? Announce yourself!
say:6:1029215004:0.source_cn: 谁？是谁在叫我的名字？报上名来！

say:8:1029215008:3.text: It IS you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Great, get me out here!
say:8:1029215008:3.male: It IS you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Great, get me out here!
say:8:1029215008:3.female: It IS you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Great, get me out here!

say:9:1029215009:1.text: And then we can fight! It's quiet here, and no one will disturb us—perfect for fighting!
say:9:1029215009:1.source_cn: 然后我们就能大战一场了。这里很安静，也不会有人打扰，简...
say:9:1029215009:1.male: And then we can fight! It's quiet here, and no one will disturb us—perfect for fighting!
say:9:1029215009:1.female: And then we can fight! It's quiet here, and no one will disturb us—perfect for fighting!

say:10:1029215010:1.text: Well, really. Trapped in a place like this, and still, all he can think about is brawling...
say:10:1029215010:1.source_cn: 真是的，都已经被困在这种地方了了，竟然还满脑子战斗战斗的……

say:11:1029215011:1.text: He's not the "battle maniac" anymore, but the "battle moron!"
say:11:1029215011:1.source_cn: 这已经不是“战斗狂”了，是“战斗笨蛋”吧！

say:14:1029215006:0.text: Huh? It seems I heard a familiar voice... But that person shouldn't be in a place like this. Could I be hallucinating...?
say:14:1029215006:0.source_cn: 嗯？好像听到了什么熟悉的声音。但那个人应该不会出现在这...

say:15:1029215007:2.text: Of course you're not! The magister is really here.
say:15:1029215007:2.source_cn: 当然不是幻觉！主人真的在这里哦。
say:15:1029215007:2.male: Of course you're not! The magister is really here.
say:15:1029215007:2.female: Of course you're not! The magister is really here.

say:2:1029216001:1.text: It's like I said, in searching for the strongest in the land, I couldn't overlook you. So, are we doing this or not?
say:2:1029216001:1.source_cn: 如我所说，在追求“最强”的道路上，你是必不可少的存在。...
say:2:1029216001:1.male: It's like I said, in searching for the strongest in the land, I couldn't overlook you. So, are we doing this or not?
say:2:1029216001:1.female: It's like I said, in searching for the strongest in the land, I couldn't overlook you. So, are we doing this or not?

choice_prompt:3:1029216001.text: It's like I said, in searching for the strongest in the land, I couldn't overlook you. So, are we doing this or not?
choice_prompt:3:1029216001.source_cn: 如我所说，在追求“最强”的道路上，你是必不可少的存在。所以……
choice_prompt:3:1029216001.male: It's like I said, in searching for the strongest in the land, I couldn't overlook you. So, are we doing this or not?
choice_prompt:3:1029216001.female: It's like I said, in searching for the strongest in the land, I couldn't overlook you. So, are we doing this or not?

say:4:1029216002:1.text: That really is such a shame. Even more of a shame than getting trapped here.
say:4:1029216002:1.source_cn: 那还真是令人遗憾。比我竟然会被这里困住还要遗憾。
say:4:1029216002:1.male: That really is such a shame. Even more of a shame than getting trapped here.
say:4:1029216002:1.female: That really is such a shame. Even more of a shame than getting trapped here.

say:5:1029216003:1.text: Anyway, weren't you on the trail of the escaped treasure thieves? How'd you end up here?
say:5:1029216003:1.source_cn: 说起来，你不是去抓逃跑的盗宝贼了吗，怎么会出现在这种地方？

say:6:1029216004:1.text: Well, I'd been following their tracks when I found this secret passage.
say:6:1029216004:1.source_cn: 之前，我追寻着那些逃兵们残留的痕迹，找到了这一处密道。

say:7:1029216005:1.text: I could smell it... The presence of someone powerful...
say:7:1029216005:1.source_cn: 我能嗅到，这里有强者存在过的气息……

say:8:1029216006:1.text: Powerful? Surely you don't mean a golem?!
say:8:1029216006:1.source_cn: “强者”…你该不会说的是魔偶吧！

say:9:1029216007:1.text: That's right. Since <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I parted ways, I haven't had the chance to battle someone worthy.
say:9:1029216007:1.male: That's right. Since <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I parted ways, I haven't had the chance to battle someone worthy.
say:9:1029216007:1.female: That's right. Since <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I parted ways, I haven't had the chance to battle someone worthy.

say:10:1029216008:1.text: So every cell in my body immediately started shaking, crying out for battle, and screaming for strength!
say:10:1029216008:1.source_cn: 所以那一瞬间，我浑身的细胞都兴奋了起来，叫嚣着战斗，叫...

say:11:1029216009:1.text: But that meant that I temporarily forgot where I was and ended up trapped in this puny mechanism.
say:11:1029216009:1.source_cn: 但正因如此，我一时间忽略了眼前的状况，反倒被这种弱小的...

say:12:1029216010:1.text: Basically, you didn't just fail to catch the treasure thieves, but you also got yourself trapped...
say:12:1029216010:1.source_cn: 简单来说，就是你不仅没追到盗宝贼，还把自己困住了……

say:13:1029216011:1.text: That is, sadly, the case. But there will always be some bumps in the road on my journey to finding the strongest! I've long been resigned to this.
say:13:1029216011:1.source_cn: 确实如此。不过，在追求“最强”的道路上，总是会遭遇些许...

say:14:1029216012:1.text: Hmph, you've got a silver tongue! But if it wasn't for the magister finding this place, who knows how long you could have been trapped here?
say:14:1029216012:1.source_cn: 哼，说得倒是好听！要不是主人带我们找到了这里，你还不知...
say:14:1029216012:1.male: Hmph, you've got a silver tongue! But if it wasn't for the magister finding this place, who knows how long you could have been trapped here?
say:14:1029216012:1.female: Hmph, you've got a silver tongue! But if it wasn't for the magister finding this place, who knows how long you could have been trapped here?

choice_prompt:15:1029216012.text: Hmph, you've got a silver tongue! But if it wasn't for the magister finding this place, who knows how long you could have been trapped here?
choice_prompt:15:1029216012.source_cn: 哼，说得倒是好听！要不是主人带我们找到了这里，你还不知道要被困多久呢。
choice_prompt:15:1029216012.male: Hmph, you've got a silver tongue! But if it wasn't for the magister finding this place, who knows how long you could have been trapped here?
choice_prompt:15:1029216012.female: Hmph, you've got a silver tongue! But if it wasn't for the magister finding this place, who knows how long you could have been trapped here?

say:16:1029216013:1.text: Robin? Oh, one of the puny thieves. What about him? Did he make any progress in his training?
say:16:1029216013:1.source_cn: 罗宾？嗯，弱小的盗宝贼之一。那家伙怎么了吗，在特训中取...
say:16:1029216013:1.male: Robin? Oh, one of the puny thieves. What about him? Did he make any progress in his training?
say:16:1029216013:1.female: Robin? Oh, one of the puny thieves. What about him? Did he make any progress in his training?

say:17:1029216014:1.text: He ran away today. The magister only found this secret passage by using the magic portal Robin left!
say:17:1029216014:1.source_cn: 罗宾今天逃跑了，主人就是顺着罗宾留下的魔法门找到这条密道的！
say:17:1029216014:1.male: He ran away today. The magister only found this secret passage by using the magic portal Robin left!
say:17:1029216014:1.female: He ran away today. The magister only found this secret passage by using the magic portal Robin left!

say:18:1029216015:1.text: Is it because he felt that the current training regimen wasn't enough?
say:18:1029216015:1.source_cn: 因为现在的训练量对罗宾来说还不足够，所以他才会选择离开吗？

say:19:1029216016:2.text: And so, in search of more training, Robin chose to come here, the secret passage of the golems—
say:19:1029216016:2.source_cn: 而为了获得更多的训练，罗宾选择来到魔偶存在的密道，也就...

say:20:1029216017:1.text: But even so, desertion is a shameful matter!
say:20:1029216017:1.source_cn: 但即使如此，当逃兵也是非常令人不齿的行为！我要亲手抓到他们！

say:21:1029216018:2.text: I'll catch him and give him even more strenuous training! As intense as my own!
say:21:1029216018:2.source_cn: 给他们增加训练强度！加到和我自己的特训强度一致！

choice:15:0:1.text: Moving on... Do you remember Robin?
choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 不说这些了，你记得罗宾吗？
choice:15:0:1.male: Moving on... Do you remember Robin?
choice:15:0:1.female: Moving on... Do you remember Robin?

choice:3:1:2.text: Don't think this means we'll fight.
choice:3:1:2.male: Don't think this means we'll fight.
choice:3:1:2.female: Don't think this means we'll fight.

say:0:1029217001:0.text: I think his priorities are totally wrong...
say:0:1029217001:0.source_cn: 这样只会让他们跑得更快吧……感觉沙奎尔的在乎的地方完全不对。
say:0:1029217001:0.male: I think his priorities are totally wrong...
say:0:1029217001:0.female: I think his priorities are totally wrong...

say:1:1029217002:0.text: Well, the next step is to find Robin after all... Let's leave it to Shakir.
say:1:1029217002:0.source_cn: 虽然事情的导向不是很对……但总归下一步是要找到他们，这...
say:1:1029217002:0.male: Well, the next step is to find Robin after all... Let's leave it to Shakir.
say:1:1029217002:0.female: Well, the next step is to find Robin after all... Let's leave it to Shakir.

say:0:1029218001:0.text: His scent... He's gotta be this way!
say:0:1029218001:0.source_cn: 有残留的气味……应该是这个方向！

say:1:1029218002:0.text: Shakir's got a really good sense of smell!

say:2:1029218003:0.text: I've always had a keen nose. Apart from sniffing out people, I can also smell the scent of power!
say:2:1029218003:0.source_cn: 我的嗅觉向来灵敏。除了找人之外，我还能嗅到强者的气息！

say:0:1029219001:0.text: The scent's getting stronger... He has to be nearby.
say:0:1029219001:0.source_cn: 气味好像变浓了一些……他们应该就在这附近了。

say:1:1029219002:0.text: Hey, look at that pile of boxes over there... Is someone there?
say:1:1029219002:0.source_cn: 诶，你们看，那边那些箱子堆积的地方……好像有人在？

say:0:1029220001:0.text: Don't worry, I've already come out!

say:1:1029220002:0.text: What do you want me to do now?

say:2:1029220003:0.text: You'll be rewarded fairly, as promised.

say:3:1029220004:0.text: However, before that, we first need to—
say:3:1029220004:0.source_cn: 不过在那之前，我们要先——

say:1:1029222001:1.text: T-These guys are a little too strong...
say:1:1029222001:1.source_cn: 这、这些人未免强的有点离谱了吧……

say:2:1029222002:1.text: I told you, we can't beat them...
say:2:1029222002:1.source_cn: 都说了，我们根本打不过他们……

say:4:1029222003:1.text: How about that? Could you feel it? The passion that only battle can bring!
say:4:1029222003:1.source_cn: 怎么样，你们感受到了吗？这种唯有战斗和力量才能带来的激情！

say:5:1029222004:1.text: I'm sorry, Boss! I made a mistake. But... But it wasn't intentional. These guys bribed me!
say:5:1029222004:1.source_cn: 沙奎尔老大，我错了！但是……但是我不是故意的，都是因为...

say:7:1029222005:1.text: What are you talking about?! It was clearly YOU who got in touch with US!
say:7:1029222005:1.source_cn: 你瞎说什么呢！明明是你主动和我们搭上线，让我们带你一起...

choice_prompt:8:1029222005.text: What are you talking about?! It was clearly YOU who got in touch with US!
choice_prompt:8:1029222005.source_cn: 你瞎说什么呢！明明是你主动和我们搭上线，让我们带你一起做生意的！

say:9:1029222006:4.text: Whoever talks first will get a lighter punishment!
say:9:1029222006:4.source_cn: 你们谁先交代，谁受的罚就更轻一些！

say:10:1029222007:1.text: Me, me! I'll talk! Didn't the Syndicate leave some treasure in their camp after they retreated? Even if most of that stuff wasn't exactly valuable, some of it would be worth something...
say:10:1029222007:1.source_cn: 我我我我说！之前黑金商会撤退之后，不是还在营地里留下了...

say:11:1029222008:2.text: Someone in the camp had the idea to smuggle some of these treasures out and sell them behind Shakir's back.
say:11:1029222008:2.source_cn: 营地里有人动了心思，想要背着沙奎尔老大，偷偷把这些宝物...

say:12:1029222009:1.text: Of c-course this kind of behavior isn't right! But money's been tight recently, and I thought about earning a bit on the side as a bonus... So I agreed to help them transport the goods.
say:12:1029222009:1.source_cn: 这、这种行为当然是不对的！但我最近手头紧，就想着多少跟...

say:13:1029222010:2.text: Let me just say that I'm not the mastermind! I'm barely even an accomplice! I just made a little mistake... Please, Boss, you gotta believe me!
say:13:1029222010:2.source_cn: 先说好，我可绝对不是主谋！我甚至连从犯都算不上，只是犯...

choice_prompt:14:1029222010.text: Let me just say that I'm not the mastermind! I'm barely even an accomplice! I just made a little mistake... Please, Boss, you gotta believe me!
choice_prompt:14:1029222010.source_cn: 先说好，我可绝对不是主谋！我甚至连从犯都算不上，只是犯了一点小错误……沙奎尔老大，你可一定要相信我啊！

say:15:1029222011:3.text: You fools! Actually trying to pull this sort of thing behind my back...
say:15:1029222011:3.source_cn: 你们这些愚蠢的家伙！竟然背着我做这种事……

say:16:1029222012:1.text: I'd never imagine you'd intentionally leave my meticulously planned special training just for this!
say:16:1029222012:1.source_cn: 我没想到的是，你们竟然会为了这些，就故意逃离我精心准备...

say:17:1029222013:1.text: You guys are so weak, yet you don't seek strength; instead, you chase after money, a meaningless external thing... it's just beyond foolish!
say:17:1029222013:1.source_cn: 你们如此弱小，却还不去追求力量，而是追求金钱这种毫无意...

choice_prompt:18:1029222013.text: You guys are so weak, yet you don't seek strength; instead, you chase after money, a meaningless external thing... it's just beyond foolish!
choice_prompt:18:1029222013.source_cn: 你们如此弱小，却还不去追求力量，而是追求金钱这种毫无意义的身外之物……简直愚不可及！

say:19:1029222014:3.text: What are you talking about? Pursue strength... PAH! You can't eat strength!
say:19:1029222014:3.source_cn: 这家伙在说什么啊！什么应该追求力量……力量又不能吃！

say:20:1029222015:1.text: Oh, but you can eat treasure? You still don't get it. The only thing worth pursuing in this world is true strength!
say:20:1029222015:1.source_cn: 难道宝物就可以吃吗？你还是不明白。只有真正的力量，才是...

say:21:1029222016:1.text: Without might, even if you got treasure, how would you protect it? If I wanted to take it from you, would you really be able to stop me?
say:21:1029222016:1.source_cn: 如果没有力量，即使你们得到了宝物，又要靠什么来守住它们...

choice_prompt:22:1029222016.text: Without might, even if you got treasure, how would you protect it? If I wanted to take it from you, would you really be able to stop me?
choice_prompt:22:1029222016.source_cn: 如果没有力量，即使你们得到了宝物，又要靠什么来守住它们？如果我想要从你们手中夺走它们，你们难道还有本事阻止我吗？

say:23:1029222017:1.text: Because I speak the truth! And absolute power is the truth!
say:23:1029222017:1.source_cn: 因为我所说的，就是真理。绝对的力量，就是真理！

say:25:1029222018:1.text: S-Shakir is right! That's it; power is the truth!
say:25:1029222018:1.source_cn: 沙、沙奎尔老大说得对！没错，力量就是真理！

say:27:1029222019:1.text: However, we should be focusing on the treasure thieves' next steps...
say:27:1029222019:1.source_cn: 不过，现在的重点是盗宝贼们下一步的计划吧……

say:28:1029222020:1.source_cn: 沙奎尔，演讲可以结束了！

say:30:1029222021:2.text: The little hamster's right. So, where are you gonna move the treasure?
say:30:1029222021:2.source_cn: 小仓鼠说得没错。所以，你们之后准备要从哪里运送宝物？

say:32:1029222022:1.text: Well, the plan was to... Hang on! You're... I'm not ratting out my friends!
say:32:1029222022:1.source_cn: 原本的计划是去……等等！你是，我是不会出卖同伴们的！

say:33:1029222023:1.text: Oh? You're very loyal to them. In that case, let me reward you with another one-on-one training session.
say:33:1029222023:1.source_cn: 哦？你对同伴们倒是很忠诚啊。既然如此，那就奖赏你，再接...

say:34:1029222024:2.text: <shk>N-No!</shk> I'm saying... Our plan was to go to a secret cave, where some of the treasure is stored...
say:34:1029222024:2.source_cn: <shk>不、不要啊！</shk>我这就说……我们原本...

say:36:1029222026:1.text: From here, keep going south. You'll find some nearby ruins that you can pass through!
say:36:1029222026:1.source_cn: 从这里出发，一直往南走。那附近有一些遗迹，打开后就能通过了！

say:38:1029222027:1.text: What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? I'd like to invite you to come with me to this secret cavern and catch those deserters.
say:38:1029222027:1.male: What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? I'd like to invite you to come with me to this secret cavern and catch those deserters.
say:38:1029222027:1.female: What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? I'd like to invite you to come with me to this secret cavern and catch those deserters.

say:39:1029222028:1.text: Then I'll personally teach those puny cowards a lesson! A tough magister like you is best suited to witness all this.
say:39:1029222028:1.source_cn: 然后，我要身体力行地教育这些弱小的逃兵们，到底什么才是...
say:39:1029222028:1.male: Then I'll personally teach those puny cowards a lesson! A tough magister like you is best suited to witness all this.
say:39:1029222028:1.female: Then I'll personally teach those puny cowards a lesson! A tough magister like you is best suited to witness all this.

choice_prompt:40:1029222028.text: Then I'll personally teach those puny cowards a lesson! A tough magister like you is best suited to witness all this.
choice_prompt:40:1029222028.source_cn: 然后，我要身体力行地教育这些弱小的逃兵们，到底什么才是“真正有用的东西”！像你这样强大的魔法师，最适合见证这一切。
choice_prompt:40:1029222028.male: Then I'll personally teach those puny cowards a lesson! A tough magister like you is best suited to witness all this.
choice_prompt:40:1029222028.female: Then I'll personally teach those puny cowards a lesson! A tough magister like you is best suited to witness all this.

say:41:1029222029:1.text: That's settled, then. Let's go, rival!
say:41:1029222029:1.source_cn: 那就这么说定了，出发吧，对手！
say:41:1029222029:1.male: That's settled, then. Let's go, rival!
say:41:1029222029:1.female: That's settled, then. Let's go, rival!

choice:40:0:1.text: Since you say it like that...
choice:40:0:1.male: Since you say it like that...
choice:40:0:1.female: Since you say it like that...

choice:40:1:2.text: I guess I should go with you.
choice:40:1:2.source_cn: 我就勉为其难去看看吧
choice:40:1:2.male: I guess I should go with you.
choice:40:1:2.female: I guess I should go with you.

choice:22:0:1.source_cn: 听起来竟然还挺有道理……

choice:22:1:2.source_cn: 我都要被沙奎尔说服了

choice:18:0:1.text: That's what you really care about?
choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 原来沙奎尔的重点是这个
choice:18:0:1.male: That's what you really care about?
choice:18:0:1.female: That's what you really care about?

choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 是沙奎尔说得出来的话……

choice:14:0:1.text: You didn't desert from the training?
choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 原来逃跑不只是因为特训
choice:14:0:1.male: You didn't desert from the training?
choice:14:0:1.female: You didn't desert from the training?

say:0:1029223001:0.text: Magister, we must be near the place the treasure thieves talked about!
say:0:1029223001:0.source_cn: 主人，盗宝贼说的地方，应该就是这附近了！
say:0:1029223001:0.male: Magister, we must be near the place the treasure thieves talked about!
say:0:1029223001:0.female: Magister, we must be near the place the treasure thieves talked about!

say:1:1029223002:0.text: Yes... That's right, I can definitely smell them here.
say:1:1029223002:0.source_cn: 嗯……没错，这里确实有那些家伙的气息。
say:1:1029223002:0.male: Yes... That's right, I can definitely smell them here.
say:1:1029223002:0.female: Yes... That's right, I can definitely smell them here.

say:2:1029223003:0.text: Let's go. Time to meet these thieves.
say:2:1029223003:0.source_cn: 走吧，我们去会会这些盗宝贼们。
say:2:1029223003:0.male: Let's go. Time to meet these thieves.
say:2:1029223003:0.female: Let's go. Time to meet these thieves.

say:0:1029224001:0.text: Magister, the three people over there look like they're... arguing?
say:0:1029224001:0.source_cn: 主人，那边好像一共有三个人的样子？不过他们看起来似乎…...
say:0:1029224001:0.male: Magister, the three people over there look like they're... arguing?
say:0:1029224001:0.female: Magister, the three people over there look like they're... arguing?

say:0:1029225001:0.text: I put in the most work! I should get half!
say:0:1029225001:0.source_cn: 我出力最多，我要拿五成！

say:1:1029225002:0.text: How dare you?! You only helped transport them half the way!
say:1:1029225002:0.source_cn: 你只帮忙运输了一段路，怎么不去抢！

say:2:1029225003:0.text: You guys... Let's just split it evenly.
say:2:1029225003:0.source_cn: 我认为你们两个说的都有问题，不如平分。

say:3:1029225004:0.text: You barely did anything! No one thinks it should be even!
say:3:1029225004:0.source_cn: 你做事最少，谁跟你平分！

say:2:1029226001:0.text: You blasted thieves! Are you not the slightest bit ashamed of what you've done?
say:2:1029226001:0.source_cn: 你们这些愚蠢的逃兵！难道就一点也不为自己的行为感到羞愧吗？

say:3:1029226002:0.text: W-what?! What's the boss doing here...? Who snitched on us?
say:3:1029226002:0.source_cn: 什、什么！沙奎尔怎么会在这里……难道我们的计划暴露了？...

say:5:1029226003:2.text: Forget about blame for now; we need to figure out how to get away from him...
say:5:1029226003:2.source_cn: 不可能。先别忙着互相责怪，还是想想怎么从沙奎尔眼皮下面...

say:6:1029226004:0.text: Get away? Hmph! Seeing as I've already found you, don't even think about running away!
say:6:1029226004:0.source_cn: 逃跑？哼，既然已经被我找到了，你们一个都别想逃！

say:1:1029228001:1.text: Do you see the beauty of absolute power? If you persevere in your special training, you'll be much stronger than you are now, even if you'll never be as strong as me!
say:1:1029228001:1.source_cn: 见识到绝对力量的魅力了吗？如果坚持特训的话，你们虽然不...

say:2:1029228002:1.text: All treasures disappear eventually. Only power will never betray you!
say:2:1029228002:1.source_cn: 不管什么宝物，最终都会消失，只有力量永远不会背叛！

say:3:1029228003:2.text: Uh... You're totally correct! You can't rely on treasures or whatever!
say:3:1029228003:2.source_cn: 呃……沙奎尔老大说得太对了！宝物什么的根本就靠不住啊！

say:4:1029228004:1.text: Not bad. Seems like you're finally able to grasp my teachings.
say:4:1029228004:1.source_cn: 不错。看来你终于能意识到力量的重要性了。

say:5:1029228005:1.text: So... Boss, what do you think about this? We'll sell this treasure together and give you some of the profits, and then you'll just forget you ever saw us. How about it?
say:5:1029228005:1.source_cn: 所以……沙奎尔老大，你看这样如何？我们一起卖掉这个宝物...

say:7:1029228007:1.text: Well, how about you take a third? Can't get much better than that—you don't even have to do anything, but you'll get a third of the profits!
say:7:1029228007:1.source_cn: 那，我们分你三分之一，如何？很够意思了吧，你什么事都不...

say:8:1029228008:1.text: You... blockhead! You really think I can be bought off as easily as you?!
say:8:1029228008:1.source_cn: 你这个……蠢货！你以为我和你们一样，会因为这点钱就被收买吗！

choice_prompt:9:1029228008.text: You... blockhead! You really think I can be bought off as easily as you?!
choice_prompt:9:1029228008.source_cn: 你这个……蠢货！你以为我和你们一样，会因为这点钱就被收买吗！

say:10:1029228009:3.text: Say what you like; there's no way I'm going back to training! You'd have to drag me back in chains!
say:10:1029228009:3.source_cn: 随便你们怎么说，反正我是绝对不会回去继续训练的！除非你...

say:11:1029228010:1.text: Who'd want to do this if it wasn't for the money?! Your dumb special training almost killed me. If it wasn't to make a little money, why would people even train?!
say:11:1029228010:1.source_cn: 要不是为了钱，谁要做这一行啊！你那什么破特训，训得命都...

say:12:1029228011:3.text: Boss, don't listen to their nonsense. I've got the perfect plan, which you definitely won't regret.
say:12:1029228011:3.source_cn: 沙奎尔老大，你别听他们乱说。我有一个完美的计划，一定不...

say:13:1029228012:1.text: Since you're stronger than even the three of us put together... Wouldn't it be easy to just take these two out of the equation?
say:13:1029228012:1.source_cn: 既然你这么强，比我们三个加起来都厉害……那要是让你消灭...

say:14:1029228013:1.text: Of course! You realize the value of strength, which means you're already better than these two!
say:14:1029228013:1.source_cn: 那是当然。你还能意识到力量的价值，已经比他们两个优秀了！

say:15:1029228014:1.text: In that case, if you get rid of those two, then we can split the profits 50-50. How about it? Isn't that a good deal?
say:15:1029228014:1.source_cn: 所以，沙奎尔老大，你把剩下那两个家伙都消灭了，然后由我...

say:16:1029228015:1.text: You... idiotic morons! I trained you with the best intentions in the world, hoping you'll rid yourselves of all this weakness...
say:16:1029228015:1.source_cn: 你们这些……这些愚不可及的家伙！我好心好意训练你们，想...

say:17:1029228016:1.text: I never thought that the only thing you wanted from the very beginning was just gold!
say:17:1029228016:1.source_cn: 没想到你们真正想要的，从一开始就只是金钱而已！

say:19:1029228018:2.text: You're... a total disappointment! I don't even care anymore and have no wish to try teaching you anything ever again. It's your loss.
say:19:1029228018:2.source_cn: 你们……你们太让我失望了！已经无所谓了，我不会再试图教...

say:20:1029228019:1.text: I'm going back to camp now to train true warriors!
say:20:1029228019:1.source_cn: 我现在就回营地，去教导真正的勇士！

say:23:1029228020:1.text: True warriors...? He can't mean the remaining treasure thieves in the camp, right?
say:23:1029228020:1.source_cn: 诶，他说的“真正的勇士”……不会是营地里剩下的盗宝贼们吧……

choice:9:0:1.text: That's how you think to bribe Shakir?
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 用这种方式收买沙奎尔吗？
choice:9:0:1.male: That's how you think to bribe Shakir?
choice:9:0:1.female: That's how you think to bribe Shakir?

say:0:1029229001:0.text: How can this place be empty? There isn't a single person here.
say:0:1029229001:0.source_cn: 这里竟然空荡荡的，一个人都没有？不可能，我不相信！

say:1:1029229002:0.text: Hmm, seems all those "true warriors" have all run off...
say:1:1029229002:0.source_cn: 呃，看起来“勇士”们都已经跑光了……

say:2:1029229003:0.text: Such a huge camp... Unbelievable... Hang on, I smell something—
say:2:1029229003:0.source_cn: 偌大一个营地，竟然连一个“真正的勇士”都不存在！等等，...

say:3:1029229004:0.text: There are two treasure thieves over there.
say:3:1029229004:0.source_cn: 那边好像有两个盗宝贼，过去问问情况吧。
say:3:1029229004:0.male: There are two treasure thieves over there.
say:3:1029229004:0.female: There are two treasure thieves over there.

say:0:1029230001:0.text: Doesn't look like there's anything of value here...
say:0:1029230001:0.source_cn: 这里好像没什么值钱的东西了……

say:1:1029230002:0.text: It's all your fault for oversleeping!

say:1:1029231001:2.text: Look on the bright side, at least we won't go hungry anymore...
say:1:1029231001:2.source_cn: 往好处想，至少我们不至于被饿死……

say:2:1029231002:2.text: If you hadn't overslept, we wouldn't be scraping the bottom of the barrel!
say:2:1029231002:2.source_cn: 要不是你睡过头了，我们哪会沦落到搜刮剩余货物！

say:3:1029231003:1.text: It's not like you woke up, either. Why are you blaming me?
say:3:1029231003:1.source_cn: 你自己不也没醒过来吗，怎么还怪我？

say:5:1029231004:2.text: What are you talking about?! "Scraping the bottom of the barrel?"
say:5:1029231004:2.source_cn: 你们在说什么？！“搜刮剩余货物”？

say:6:1029231005:1.text: Argh! The boss is back... Damn, it's over! Do we still have time to run?
say:6:1029231005:1.source_cn: 呜哇！沙奎尔大人竟然回来了……完了完了完了，我们现在逃...

say:7:1029231006:1.text: Boss! W-We're not doing anything bad! We're... standing guard here and waiting for you to get back!
say:7:1029231006:1.source_cn: 沙奎尔大人！我们、我们什么都没做！我们……正守在这里等...

choice_prompt:8:1029231006.text: Boss! W-We're not doing anything bad! We're... standing guard here and waiting for you to get back!
choice_prompt:8:1029231006.source_cn: 沙奎尔大人！我们、我们什么都没做！我们……正守在这里等您回来呢！

say:10:1029231008:1.text: Hey, you two. What exactly happened here after I left with <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:10:1029231008:1.male: Hey, you two. What exactly happened here after I left with <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:10:1029231008:1.female: Hey, you two. What exactly happened here after I left with <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:12:1029231009:1.text: Well... when everyone noticed you're gone, they took the opportunity to divide up everything in the camp before running off...
say:12:1029231009:1.source_cn: 这个……其实，也没什么，就是，就是大家看没人管了，赶紧...

say:13:1029231010:1.text: The two of us overslept by accident, and got left behind. We were looking at what was left over...
say:13:1029231010:1.source_cn: 我们两个不小心睡过了头，所以没来得及离开，只能留下来看...

say:15:1029231011:2.text: Hey! Why are you telling the truth?!
say:15:1029231011:2.source_cn: 喂！你怎么把真话说出来了！

say:16:1029231012:1.text: Huh? I mean, of course we didn't oversleep! We took the initiative to stay behind to report to you, boss!
say:16:1029231012:1.source_cn: 啊？啊！不、不对，我们没有睡过头，我们是主动留下来等着...

say:17:1029231013:1.text: Enough. It's time to end this farce.
say:17:1029231013:1.source_cn: 够了。我已经清楚地知道一切了。这场闹剧也是时候该结束了。

say:18:1029231014:1.text: You two, get lost! And don't ever show your faces to me again!
say:18:1029231014:1.source_cn: 你们两个，都给我滚！永远别再出现在我面前了！

say:19:1029231015:1.source_cn: 呜啊啊啊！我们这就滚，这就滚！

choice:8:1:2.text: These two don't look very smart...
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 这两位看起来不太聪明……
choice:8:1:2.male: These two don't look very smart...
choice:8:1:2.female: These two don't look very smart...

say:0:1029232001:0.text: But we didn't get any of the leftover rations...

say:1:1029232002:0.text: Just be happy that idiot let us go. Let's get outta here!
say:1:1029232002:0.source_cn: 蠢狼狗放过我们你就知足吧，快跑！

say:3:1029233001:1.text: I can't believe those imbeciles were that unreasonable... They're obsessed with treasure and riches, rather than what's truly important!
say:3:1029233001:1.source_cn: 这些愚蠢的家伙，简直不可理喻……他们竟然对宝物和钱财如...

say:4:1029233002:1.text: Strength is clearly the only thing of value! Without strength, everything else is meaningless!
say:4:1029233002:1.source_cn: 明明只有力量才是最有价值的东西！没有力量，其他任何东西...

say:5:1029233003:1.text: They'll regret their own ignorance and disrespect one day!
say:5:1029233003:1.source_cn: 他们总有一天会后悔的。为自己的无知，以及这种对力量毫无...

choice_prompt:6:1029233003.text: They'll regret their own ignorance and disrespect one day!
choice_prompt:6:1029233003.source_cn: 他们总有一天会后悔的。为自己的无知，以及这种对力量毫无尊敬的态度而追悔万分！

say:7:1029233004:1.text: Sure enough, you're the only one in existence who can understand me.
say:7:1029233004:1.source_cn: 果然，只有你才是最能理解我的存在。
say:7:1029233004:1.male: Sure enough, you're the only one in existence who can understand me.
say:7:1029233004:1.female: Sure enough, you're the only one in existence who can understand me.

say:8:1029233005:1.text: Shall we seize the moment to have a battle in commemoration of this great friendship?
say:8:1029233005:1.source_cn: 不如我们趁机来一场决斗，纪念一下这番伟大的友谊！我相信...
say:8:1029233005:1.male: Shall we seize the moment to have a battle in commemoration of this great friendship?
say:8:1029233005:1.female: Shall we seize the moment to have a battle in commemoration of this great friendship?

say:10:1029233006:1.text: Don't try to drag our magister into a fight!
say:10:1029233006:1.source_cn: 不要趁机拉主人陪你打架！
say:10:1029233006:1.male: Don't try to drag our magister into a fight!
say:10:1029233006:1.female: Don't try to drag our magister into a fight!

say:11:1029233008:2.text: Never mind. I've wasted enough time here. It's time to get down to business.
say:11:1029233008:2.source_cn: 罢了。我已经在这里浪费了不少时间，也是时候该做些正事了。
say:11:1029233008:2.male: Never mind. I've wasted enough time here. It's time to get down to business.
say:11:1029233008:2.female: Never mind. I've wasted enough time here. It's time to get down to business.

say:12:1029233009:1.text: The Warsong Festival begins soon, and I need to be in tip-top physical shape before it starts. Thus, I've decided to leave tomorrow and return to the Ashen Wastes.

say:12:1029233009:1.male: The Warsong Festival begins soon, and I need to be in tip-top physical shape before it starts. Thus, I've decided to leave tomorrow and return to the Ashen Wastes.
say:12:1029233009:1.female: The Warsong Festival begins soon, and I need to be in tip-top physical shape before it starts. Thus, I've decided to leave tomorrow and return to the Ashen Wastes.

say:15:1029233011:1.source_cn: 建立部族？听起来好厉害的样子！

say:16:1029233012:2.text: It is. When the time comes, I'll carefully select each and every member. They must all thirst for power and will never be blinded by things like treasure and riches!

choice_prompt:18:1029233013.text: Of course, I'll also prepare the strictest training regimen for them. My warriors will grow ever stronger, and together we'll strive for ultimate power!
choice_prompt:18:1029233013.source_cn: 当然，我还会给他们安排最严苛的训练，让勇士们变得更强，一起追求最强大的力量！

say:19:1029233014:1.text: Thank you. I believe in myself.
say:19:1029233014:1.source_cn: 感谢你的祝福，我一定会的。
say:19:1029233014:1.male: Thank you. I believe in myself.
say:19:1029233014:1.female: Thank you. I believe in myself.

say:20:1029233019:2.text: So this is where we part, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:20:1029233019:2.male: So this is where we part, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:20:1029233019:2.female: So this is where we part, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:21:1029233020:1.text: Happy times are always so very short, but I will cherish the memories of our time together.
say:21:1029233020:1.source_cn: 快乐的时光总是很短暂，我会珍惜与你一共经历过的回忆。
say:21:1029233020:1.male: Happy times are always so very short, but I will cherish the memories of our time together.
say:21:1029233020:1.female: Happy times are always so very short, but I will cherish the memories of our time together.

say:22:1029233021:2.text: Although it's a shame we never got to fight, I believe that we will meet again.
say:22:1029233021:2.source_cn: 虽然最后没能和你决斗一场很令人遗憾，不过我相信，强者终...
say:22:1029233021:2.male: Although it's a shame we never got to fight, I believe that we will meet again.
say:22:1029233021:2.female: Although it's a shame we never got to fight, I believe that we will meet again.

say:24:1029233015:1.text: No need, I can safely return to the Ashen Wastes by virtue of my strength alone.

say:24:1029233015:1.female: No need, I can safely return to the Ashen Wastes by virtue of my strength alone.

say:25:1029233016:1.source_cn: 那你要是没有足够的物资了怎么办？会饿肚子的！

say:26:1029233017:1.text: I shall solve that with my strength, of course! Ultimately, there isn't a single problem in this world that cannot be solved with force. Do you not agree?
say:26:1029233017:1.source_cn: 那当然也是依靠力量解决！说到底，这个世界上根本没有力量...

say:27:1029233018:1.text: Uh... As long as you think it'll be fine...

say:28:1029233007:1.text: You're right. I should never have cared so much about those idiots in the first place...

say:28:1029233007:1.female: You're right. I should never have cared so much about those idiots in the first place...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1029211001:.text: Well, that went without a hitch! I'm gonna make a fortune!
